paite: Pathian hehpihna phattuampih lou a na tanlouhna ding un, amah seppih koute'n ka hon ngen petmah uhi.
english: Working together, we entreat also that you do not receive the grace of God in vain.

paite: "Hun kipahhuai ah ka hon ngaikhia a, hotdamna ni ah ka hon panpih," achi ngal a. Ngai un, tu hun kipahuai ahi a; ngai in, tu hotdamna ni ahi!
english: For he says, “At an acceptable time I listened to you. In a day of salvation I helped you.” Behold, now is the acceptable time. Behold, now is the day of salvation.

paite: Ka nasepna uh dem a a-omlouhna ding in bang lam peuh ah kuamah pukloh ding himhim ka bawl kei uhi.
english: We give no occasion of stumbling in anything, that our service may not be blamed,

paite: Pathian nasemte bang in bangkim ah mi mit tung in ka om zaw zel ua, nakpi a kuhkalna ah, gentheihna ah, taksapnate ah, lunggimnate ah;
english: but in everything commending ourselves as servants of God: in great endurance, in afflictions, in hardships, in distresses,

paite: vuaknate ah, hentaknate ah, mipihon buainate ah, sepgimnate ah, zan ihmutmohnate ah leh gilkialna ah;
english: in beatings, in imprisonments, in riots, in labors, in watchings, in fastings,

paite: sianthouna in, theihna in, kuhkalna in, migitna in, Kha Siangthou in leh
english: in pureness, in knowledge, in perseverance, in kindness, in the Holy Spirit, in sincere love,

paite: thutak thu in, Pathian thilhihtheihna in; taklam leh veilam a diktatna galvante zang in;
english: in the word of truth, in the power of God, by the armor of righteousness on the right hand and on the left,

paite: pahtawina ah leh pahtawilouhna ah, min gensiat leh min genhoihna ah leng;
english: by glory and dishonor, by evil report and good report, as deceivers and yet true,

paite: midiktat hi ngal in mikhemte bang a bawl in ka om ua; minthangtak hi ngal in theih tham louh bang in, si dek phial a vuak a om a, hihlup louh in, ngai dih ua, ka hing ua;
english: as unknown and yet well known, as dying and behold—we live, as punished and not killed,

paite: lungkhamtak bang a om in, lah kipak gige ngal in; zawngtak bang a om in, lah bangkim a midangte hausa a bawl in, bangmah nei lou bang in, lah thil bangkim nei hi ngal in.
english: as sorrowful yet always rejoicing, as poor yet making many rich, as having nothing and yet possessing all things.

paite: Korinthte aw, koute'n zalentak in ka gen ua, ka lungtang uh zatak in akihong hi.
heading: Piangthakte Itna Ngetna
english: Our mouth is open to you, Corinthians. Our heart is enlarged.

paite: Noute a ding in phal louh bangmah ka nei kei ua, nou bel na thil deihlam uah phal louh tan na nei uhi.
english: You are not restricted by us, but you are restricted by your own affections.

paite: Huchi in ka hon piak bangbang hon pethuk sam ding in (tate kiang a gen bang in ka gen ahi), nou leng na lungtangte uh zasak sam un.
english: Now in return—I speak as to my children—you also open your hearts.

paite: Ginglou mite toh kituakloupi a hakkol pokhawm in om kei un; diktatlouhna leh diktatna in bang ahia kikopna aneih uh? Ahihkeileh, mial leh vak in bang ahia kithuahna aneih uh?
english: Don’t be unequally yoked with unbelievers, for what fellowship do righteousness and iniquity have? Or what fellowship does light have with darkness?

paite: Belial leh Khrist in bang ahia kituahna aneih uh? Ahihkeileh, gingloumi leh gingtami'n bang ahia tankhawm aneih uh?
english: What agreement does Christ have with Belial? Or what portion does a believer have with an unbeliever?

paite: Milimte leh Pathian tempul in leng bang ahia kituahna aneih uh? Eite zaw Pathian hing tempul i hi ngal ua; Pathian in, "Amaute ah ka teng dia, amau lak ah leng ka khosa ding; huan a Pathian uh ka hi dia, amau leng ka mite ahi ding uh, achih bang in.
english: What agreement does a temple of God have with idols? For you are a temple of the living God. Even as God said, “I will dwell in them and walk in them. I will be their God and they will be my people.”

paite: Huaiziak in alak ua kipan in hong pawt unla, atuam in om un, thilsiang lou himhim khoih kei un, Toupa'n achi, huchi in ka hon kipahpih dia,
english: Therefore “‘Come out from among them, and be separate,’ says the Lord. ‘Touch no unclean thing. I will receive you.

paite: noute a ding in na Pa uh ka hi dia, noute leng kei a ding in tanute leh tapate na hi ding uh, Toupa Bangkim hihthei in achi," chi in.
english: I will be to you a Father. You will be to me sons and daughters,’ says the Lord Almighty.”
